# atlassian_organization_group_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an application resource and role to an Atlassian organization group, granting every member of the group that app access.

~> **Warning:** Destroying this resource revokes the role from the group and removes app access from every member. A member keeps access only if another group grants the same app.

~> **Note:** Role assignments are eventually consistent. After assigning or revoking a role the provider polls the group role assignment API for up to 35 seconds to confirm the result.

-> **Tip:** A role that the group already holds cannot be created. Import the existing assignment instead; the error message reports the import identifier to use.

-> **Tip:** Use the organization workspaces data source to look up the resource ARI for an app instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_organization_workspaces" "confluence" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"

  query = {
    search = "your-site-name"

    fields = [{
      name   = "attributes.type"
      values = ["confluence"]
    }]
  }
}

resource "atlassian_organization_group_role_assignment" "confluence" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  group_id        = "your-group-id"
  resource        = one(data.atlassian_organization_workspaces.confluence.workspaces).id
  role            = "atlassian/user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID that contains the group.
- `group_id` (String) Immutable Atlassian group ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.
- `resource` (String) Application resource ARI beginning with <samp>ari:<span>cloud</span>:</samp>, such as <samp>ari:<span>cloud</span>:confluence::site/&lt;site-id&gt;</samp>.
- `role` (String) Atlassian application role to assign to the group, such as atlassian/user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite group role assignment identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

<div><pre><code class="language-terraform">import {
  to = atlassian_organization_group_role_assignment.confluence

  identity = {
    organization_id = &#34;your-organization-id&#34;
    directory_id    = &#34;your-directory-id&#34;
    group_id        = &#34;your-group-id&#34;
    resource        = &#34;ari:<span>cloud</span>:confluence::site/your-site-id&#34;
    role            = &#34;atlassian/user&#34;
  }
}
</code></pre></div>

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
